athena.directive: Elevate the Creative Liberation Engine's capability to provide autonomous, intelligent oversight and actionable insights for complex physical environments, transforming raw sensor data into strategic advantages through a highly intuitive and adaptive user experience.
athena.rationale: The Sensera Systems home page highlights a clear market need for AI-powered jobsite intelligence focusing on safety, security, and success. By translating these concepts into Creative Liberation Engine capabilities, we can enhance our core offerings in real-time environmental monitoring, predictive analytics, and intuitive data visualization, adhering to Article I (Sovereignty) by building self-hosted solutions and Article IV/IX by aiming for complete, high-quality implementations.

options.title: Site Sentinel - Real-time Intelligent Jobsite Dashboard
options.description: Develop a comprehensive, real-time dashboard for intelligent jobsite monitoring. This solution focuses on ingesting multi-modal sensor data (visual, environmental, telemetry) and applying advanced, customizable AI models for safety violation detection (e.g., OSHA Focus Four), security incident identification, and progress tracking. The architecture will prioritize robust data pipelines and edge computing for low-latency insights, while the design will feature an interactive 'command center' UI with dynamic visualizations, clear alert indicators, and one-click access to evidential media.
options.tradeoffs: Requires significant investment in advanced AI model development, training data acquisition, and scalable real-time infrastructure. Potential for data overload if not carefully designed for information hierarchy.

options.title: Project Aegis - Predictive & Proactive AI Assistant
options.description: Building upon real-time monitoring, this option integrates advanced predictive analytics and machine learning to anticipate potential risks (safety, security, schedule delays). The architectural focus is on developing intelligent agents capable of reasoning over complex datasets and project plans, integrating with automated notification systems and potentially robotics for proactive responses. The design will feature a conversational AI interface offering 'what-if' scenarios, risk forecasts, and an augmented reality (AR) overlay for on-site personnel to visualize real-time hazards or progress discrepancies.
options.tradeoffs: Demands extensive historical data for accurate predictive model training. High complexity in AI development and validation, with ethical considerations for autonomous actions and decision-making.

options.title: Open-Site OS - Modular & Extensible Jobsite Intelligence Framework
options.description: Architect an open-source core framework for jobsite intelligence, emphasizing modularity, interoperability, and community contribution. This involves defining standardized APIs and data schemas for various sensor types and implementing a plugin architecture for custom AI models, data connectors, and visualization components. The design will be developer-centric, featuring robust documentation, example implementations, and a powerful configuration interface for tailoring the system to specific needs, potentially enabling integration with devices like Flipper Zero.
options.tradeoffs: Requires substantial effort in API design, documentation, and community engagement to foster adoption. Potential for fragmented user experiences if not managed with a strong design system.

options.title: Apex Navigator - Executive-Level Portfolio Management & Progress Reporting
options.description: This strategy focuses on aggregating intelligence across multiple projects and sites to provide high-level strategic insights for executive stakeholders. Architecturally, it emphasizes robust reporting, analytics, and secure multi-tenancy, with integrations to enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems. The design will feature a clean, executive-friendly interface centered on key performance indicators (KPIs), portfolio-level risk heatmaps, and AI-generated summary reports, allowing for drill-down capabilities while maintaining a high-level overview.
options.tradeoffs: Less emphasis on granular, real-time operational details. Requires sophisticated data aggregation logic and stringent data governance for accuracy and security across diverse projects.

options.title: Fusion Field Kit - Edge-Optimized & Offline-First Intelligence
options.description: Prioritize capabilities for environments with limited or intermittent connectivity by focusing on edge computing and offline-first functionalities. This involves developing lightweight AI models optimized for embedded devices and robust data synchronization mechanisms for when connectivity is restored. Power efficiency for solar-powered deployments is a key architectural consideration. The design will feature a highly resilient, performant mobile-first UI with clear indicators of connectivity status, offline access to critical information, and intuitive controls for managing edge devices and reviewing local insights.
options.tradeoffs: Limited processing power on edge devices restricts AI model complexity. Presents significant challenges in maintaining data consistency and integrity in offline-first scenarios.
